fit_reason: This is a human-powered sea kayak (Dagger Cortez 15.0), not a car, truck, motorcycle, boat with gelcoat, PWC or pontoon we would detail. It is a rotomolded polyethylene hull with no paint, gelcoat or interior to work on.
findings: Yellow polyethylene hull and deck look clean and bright in all photos
Cockpit seat and back band look clean with no visible grime
Deck rigging, hatch covers and rudder look intact and tidy
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Dagger Cortez kayak. It looks clean and well kept in the photos, with a bright yellow deck and a tidy cockpit. Kayaks aren't really something our detailing service covers, but if you have a car or boat you're getting ready to sell, we come to you for pre-sale details. Would you like a quote on anything like that?
